lines.t: You said the things we didn't want to hear
Split our comfort open with your light
You touched the places we had locked in fear
Pulled our painted idols into sight
You let the silence echo in our chest
Till every hiding place began to shake
You would not call our compromise the best
You loved us far too much to let us fade
Every cutting word was mercy in disguise
Every burning truth, a door before our eyes If you had spoken softly, we'd have stayed
asleep Smiling in the shadows, sinking in the deep
But you shattered all our pretty fragile lies Taught us how to live beneath your blazing
So we break and we bow and we bleed and we burn
Till our hearts say yes to every hard word we learn
You weighed the motives we could not confess
Laid holy pressure on our hidden schemes
You let our finest garments feel like less
Strip the painted halos from our dreams
You showed us we were rich in our own name
You starved for living water at the well
You turned our secret pride into a flame
That lit the cracks we carefully concealed
Every shaken floor was kindness from above
above Every shattered wall and entrance for your
love If you had spoken softly we would never change
Age dancing in the ruins calling it okay But you tore through all the curtains we had
drawn Pulled us from the midnight into blood red
So we fall and we cry and we heal and we learn
As your fierce compassion teaches hearts to turn
Let every wound become a window
Let every tear become a sea
Where all our self-defense is drowning
And only truth is left in me
Let every no that once defied you
Melt inside this holy fire
Till what you love is what I'm loving
What you hate has lost its air
Thank you.
If you had spoken softly, we'd have died in peace
Blessed by our illusions, never truly free
But you broke us just enough to make us whole
Pulled the thorns out of the center of our soul
Now we run, we return to the one we had spurned
Finding in your hardest words the love we've always yearned
Thank you.
